holdout_card.topic_name: Collapse of Thailand State Audit Office building
holdout_card.source_page: Collapse of Thailand State Audit Office building
holdout_card.fact_statement: The Ministry of Labour provided compensation for relatives of those who died in the collapse.
holdout_card.source_span: The Ministry of Labour announced that it would provide up to two million baht in compensation for relatives of each those who died

qa_variants.question: What did the Ministry of Labour provide for the relatives of those who died in the collapse of the Thailand State Audit Office building?
qa_variants.source_span: The Ministry of Labour announced that it would provide up to two million baht in compensation for relatives of each those who died
